user.title: Connect to a SlideShow player
user.description: Enter the address of the SlideShow web interface. Rooted devices normally use port 80, other devices use port 8080.

data_description.verify_ssl: SlideShow generates a self-signed certificate on first start, so leave this off unless you have uploaded your own.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the SlideShow player
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for this player were rejected. Enter the current web interface login.

reconfigure.title: Change the player's address
reconfigure.description: Use this if the player's IP address or port has changed. The panel address and all entities are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the player. Check the host and port, and that the device is on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected by the player.
error.no_device_id: The player did not report a device ID and cannot be identified.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different SlideShow player than this one.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a configured SlideShow player.

init.title: SlideShow options

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the player for its status. Lower values react faster but put more load on the device.
data_description.panel_template: Jinja template rendered by Home Assistant and streamed to the panel whenever the entities it uses change. It only needs to produce markup — the page supplies the styling. Edit the lists at the top to match your own entities.
data_description.screen_off_layout: Name of the screen layout SlideShow shows while a layout schedule has the display powered down. Selecting it turns the screen off; clearing the layout turns it back on. Change this if your player reports a different name.

init.description: The live panel is a page Home Assistant serves for this player. Put the Panel URL sensor's value into a web page content item in SlideShow to show it permanently.

show_file.name: Show file
show_file.description: Displays a single file from the player's storage, overriding the current playlist.

file.name: File
file.description: Path to the file within SlideShow, for example image.jpg or nested/file.mp4.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the file, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in, or "audio" for the audio playlist. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

show_html.name: Show HTML
show_html.description: Renders a block of HTML on the screen, overriding the current playlist. Useful for pushing templated content from Home Assistant.

html.name: HTML
html.description: The HTML to render. Set a text colour, for example color: #fff — the player draws HTML on a black background but defaults the text colour to black too, so unstyled HTML appears as a blank black screen.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the content, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

show_stream.name: Show stream
show_stream.description: Displays a video stream, overriding the current playlist.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the stream, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

set_playlist.name: Set playlist
set_playlist.description: Switches a zone to a particular playlist. Give at least one of playlist ID, name or number.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to play the playlist, in seconds. Omit to play until changed.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to play in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to play in. Defaults to the main zone.

set_layout.name: Set screen layout
set_layout.description: Switches the player to a particular screen layout. Give at least one of layout ID or name.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to show the layout, in seconds. Omit to show until changed.

synchronize.name: Synchronize files
synchronize.description: Triggers a file synchronization from an external server.

method.name: Method
method.description: HTTP method to use (GET, POST or PUT).

target.name: Target
target.description: Target file or folder within SlideShow. Required by the device.

clear_folder.name: Clear folder
clear_folder.description: Whether to empty the target folder before downloading.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Displays a camera on the player. Uses the camera's own RTSP stream when it has one, and falls back to a still image that refreshes every second.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show the camera, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

install_panel.name: Install panel
install_panel.description: Adds the live dashboard to the player as its own playlist, so it can be chosen like any other. Home Assistant serves a small .url file, tells the player to download it, and creates a content entry pointing at it.

content_name.name: Name
content_name.description: Name for the content entry on the player.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Name of the .url file stored on the player.

create_content.name: Create content
create_content.description: Creates a content entry on the player and returns its content and playlist IDs. Each entry gets a playlist of its own, which then appears in the Playlist select.

path.name: Path
path.description: Folder or file within SlideShow for the ordering types, or the address for a stream, RSS feed or YouTube video.

delete_content.name: Delete content
delete_content.description: Deletes a content entry. The device refuses if the entry is used in a schedule.

content_id.name: Content ID
content_id.description: ID of the entry, as returned by Create content.
